title: An AI was given one paragraph of Lord of the Rings
title_candidates: An AI was given one paragraph of Lord of the Rings
This Lord of the Rings scene was coded, not drawn
What happens when the smartest AI reads Tolkien
One of the top AI researchers just ran this creativity test
No brushes, no studio. Just a paragraph and an AI
caption:
A top AI researcher gave one paragraph from Lord of the Rings to the world's most powerful AI. It turned those words into art, writing the code that draws each detail from scratch.

Andrej Karpathy, who used to lead AI at Tesla, ran this as a creativity test. The old benchmark was 'draw a pelican on a bike.' Now it's illustrating Tolkien. People are already asking who will fund doing the entire trilogy this way.
